title: The Silent Garden
author: Zephyrine Delacroix
blurb: Jonah Montrose, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
